# UseMoney Apply Dialog Area Columns Need Dictionary Formatter
pubUseMoneyApply/detail.vue showPropertyProjectDialog binds street/community columns directly to code fields without using the area mixin formatter to show Chinese names.

## Problem
- In pubUseMoneyApply/detail.vue showPropertyProjectDialog, the street (街道) and community (社区) columns bind directly to code fields.
- They do not use the area mixin's formatter to convert codes to Chinese names.

## Fix
- Add formatter: this.subdistrictFormatter and this.communityFormatter to both columns.
- Depends on detailMixins importing the area mixin to load the dictionary.

## Verification and Attribution
- Files: pubUseMoneyApply/detail.vue, ruoyi.js, pubParkingRate/detail.vue, detailMixins.js, assetsLeaseContractFiling/detail.vue, property/useMoneyApply/detail.vue, area.js, zs-select-dialog-func.vue.
- Project: 园区公共收益; source session: 414b600e-25ec-4a22-8966-2b35fffacd1d; code baseline: none.

# Expenditure Contract Dialog Area Columns Lack Dictionary Formatter
pubExpenditureContract/detail.vue property-management-area select dialog binds street/community columns to code fields without converting to names.

## Problem
- In pubExpenditureContract/detail.vue property-management-area select dialog, street (街道) and community (社区) columns bind to subdistrict/community code fields.
- The codes are not converted to Chinese names.

## Fix
- Add formatter: this.subdistrictFormatter and this.communityFormatter to the columns.
- Reuse the area mixin dictionary loaded via detailMixins.

## Verification and Attribution
- Files: pubExpenditureContract/detail.vue, pubPaymentNotice/detail.vue, pubRegulatoryAccount/detail.vue, assetLeaseApply/detail.vue, area.js, detailMixins.js, zs-select-dialog-func.vue, zs-select-dialog.vue.
- Project: 园区公共收益; source session: fad5a385-6cf5-49cb-86a0-1abe38b27af6; code baseline: none.

- Dialog onClose should guard this.$refs['form'].resetFields() with a ref-existence check, or skip reset when dialogFormMode === 'view', because view mode renders DetailTemplate without a ref='form' zs-form so this.$refs.form is undefined.

# 选择弹窗辅助链接无权限用 Optional 路由解析
园区公共收益 benefit 等业务选择弹窗的辅助链接，无菜单权限时应用 getRouterPathByFilePathOptional 静默跳过，避免连弹授权错误。

## 现象
- 选择弹窗选项旁挂「前往开户」「签署协议」等辅助链接，用 getRouterPathByFilePath 解析，无菜单权限时每次调用都弹「没有授权相关菜单」。
- 多个链接连弹多条相同错误，且区域选择本身仍应可用。

## 根因
- getRouterPathByFilePath 在缺菜单时直接报错，未区分「无权限静默跳过」与「区域选择可用」的场景。

## 修复方案
- 参照 pubUseMoneyApply/detail.vue：辅助链接一律走 getRouterPathByFilePathOptional，有权限渲染链接，无权限静默跳过。
- assetLeaseApply、pubBankReceiptApply 等同写法页面需批量排查。

## 验证与归属
- 验证：无「监管账户开户/监管协议签署」菜单时 getRouterPathByFilePath 连弹两条相同授权错误，改 Optional 后弹窗可正常选区域。
- 涉及文件：ruoyi.js、assetLeaseApply/detail.vue、pubUseMoneyApply/detail.vue。
- 所属项目：园区公共收益；来源会话：82837732-6269-4a38-bb56-614e39f5bbeb；代码基线：36a9a7e。

# Optional Router Path for Select Dialog Auxiliary Links
The park-benefit (园区公共收益) benefit module select dialogs use getRouterPathByFilePathOptional to silently skip auxiliary links when the user lacks menu permission, avoiding repeated authorization errors.

## Symptom
- Select-dialog options show auxiliary links such as "前往开户" (open account) / "签署协议" (sign agreement) resolved via getRouterPathByFilePath; with no menu permission each call pops "没有授权相关菜单" (no authorized menu).
- B-terminal showPropertyProjectDialog calls getRouterPathByFilePath to parse no-permission menu routes and the thrown error blocks the whole area-selection dialog.
- Multiple links pop duplicate identical errors while the area selection itself should stay usable.

## Root Cause
- getRouterPathByFilePath raises an error directly when the menu is missing, not distinguishing "silent skip when no permission" from "area selection still usable".

## Fix
- Added getRouterPathByFilePathOptional in ruoyi.js that returns null instead of throwing.
- pubUseMoneyApply/detail.vue adds extraLinks only when the resolved route exists.
- Auxiliary links should all go through getRouterPathByFilePathOptional; render link when permitted, silently skip otherwise. assetLeaseApply and pubBankReceiptApply need the same batch check.

## Verification and Attribution
- Verified: without 监管账户开户/监管协议签署 menu, getRouterPathByFilePath popped two identical auth errors; after switching to Optional the dialog selects area normally.
- Files: ruoyi.js, assetLeaseApply/detail.vue, pubUseMoneyApply/detail.vue, pubUseMoneyApply2/detail.vue, pubBankReceiptApply/detail.vue, zs-select-dialog-func.vue, regulatoryAccountPanel.vue.
- Project: 园区公共收益; source sessions: 82837732-6269-4a38-bb56-614e39f5bbeb, 5922f357-1df8-46c0-8045-f0e84afd364d; code baseline: 36a9a7e.
